> **Recommended: Python 3.13** — stable, fully supported, and widely compatible with modern libraries. **Python 3.14** is available if you target the newest features, but ensure compliance with external dependencies.

Each Python version gets ~2 years of full bug-fix releases, then ~3 years of security-only patches, for a total of 5 years of support. After that it's EOL — no more patches, ever.
